## Download

Pick the zip for your computer. Nothing to install, and no admin rights needed.

| Computer | Download |
| --- | --- |
| **Windows** | `ClassQuest-win-x64.zip` |
| Mac with an Apple chip (M1 or newer) | `ClassQuest-mac-arm64.zip` |
| Older Intel Mac | `ClassQuest-mac-x64.zip` |
| Linux | `ClassQuest-linux-x64.zip` |

## Start it (Windows)

1. Download `ClassQuest-win-x64.zip`. Right-click it → **Properties** → tick **Unblock** if you see it → **OK**.
2. Right-click the zip → **Extract All…** and extract it to Documents or the Desktop. (Don't run it from inside the zip.)
3. Open the **ClassQuest** folder and double-click **Start Class Quest**. If Windows says it protected your PC, click **More info → Run anyway**.
4. Your browser opens **Teacher controls** on the **Canvas** tab. Paste your Canvas address and an access token, pick your course, and you're done.

Keep the black Class Quest window open while you use it, and close it to stop. To show the display on a classroom TV or another computer, use **Show on other devices** instead.

Each zip includes the official Node.js program from nodejs.org, checked against its published checksum.
